_doc: Welcome intro ("Précision en mouvement"). Single source of truth shared by the Remotion project (video-studio/) and the site build (scripts/build.mjs, src/assets/js/intro.js). Units: composition pixels and seconds. Change the layout here, re-render, then rebuild the site so the live handoff matches the video.

logo._content: opaque bounds of the artwork inside the PNG (x0, y0, x1, y1)
logo._topDuct: the mark's top horizontal duct, measured on the PNG: body between the flanges, and the flanges' outer box

desktop._safe: rect (x, y, w, h) that must stay visible on any screen ratio; the page never crops inside it

_timing: seconds of video time. scenes follow the brief; handoff is when the page takes over from the video
_background: flat background colour of the video and of the page overlay over time; ends on the hero colour (--bg, dark theme)
_langs: languages rendered and shown. Only add en/ar once their wording below is approved and their videos are rendered.
